items.a: Forma Estates is an AI platform for professional property visualization. You upload images of a property and get within seconds: stylish AI visualizations of the rooms in up to 8 design styles, a cinematic property video with AI camera movements and beat-synchronized music, a transformation video animating the transition from before to after, a 3D floor plan from your 2D floor plan, and professional PDF presentations with before/after comparison — all ready for listings, social media, project materials and client presentations.

The platform is used by real estate agents, property developers, construction companies, homeowner associations, rental companies and other property industry professionals. Whether you're selling, renting, renovating or presenting a project, Forma Estates gives you professional visualizations in seconds.

items.q: What are AI visualizations and transformation videos?
items.a: AI visualizations are still images where the AI redesigns the room in a chosen style — walls, floor and windows remain unchanged while furniture, lighting and surfaces are replaced. Transformation videos are 5-second video clips animating the transition from the original room to the redesigned one — ideal for showing the property's potential on Instagram, in project presentations and in listings.

The Showcase video combines your property images into a vertical 9:16 video with AI-generated camera movements (dolly, orbit, panning) and beat-synchronized background music. The result is a professional reel ready for Instagram, Facebook, property portals and project websites — without a camera crew or video editing.

Subscriptions start from 2,999 DKK/month and give access to all features: AI visualizations, transformation videos, property videos, 3D floor plans and PDF presentations. Contact us for a quote tailored to your company or team.

items.q: What file formats can I upload?
items.a: We support JPG and PNG. For best results the image should be at least 800×600 pixels and taken in good natural light. Avoid strong backlighting or very dark rooms — the better the input, the better the output.

items.q: Can I use the material in marketing and presentations?
items.a: Yes. All generated visualizations, videos and PDFs can be downloaded and used freely in ads, project material, social media and client presentations. We recommend clearly labeling AI-generated images in accordance with industry guidelines.

items.q: Does the AI preserve the room's structure?
items.a: Yes. Walls, windows, floor and the room's proportions remain unchanged. Only furniture, lighting and surfaces are redesigned, so the result looks realistic and credible to potential buyers, tenants and investors.
Yes. Uploaded images are used solely to generate your visualization and are not shared with third parties. See our privacy policy for full details on data protection.
